articles.title: Bitcoin hits $72,000 as Strategy and Coinbase continue rally
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has gained 15% since monday, reclaiming several key technical and on-chain levels as bullish momentum builds.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Where DeFi yield really comes from (and why it broke this spring)
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Solstice Finance's David Plisek argues that most of the money lost in DeFi this spring wasn't taken by hackers but by yield strategies that quietly stopped working. Looking at April's $13 billion drawdown, he shows that a headline yield number reveals almost nothing about whether it will hold under stress, laying out four questions an allocator should ask before committing capital.

articles.title: Bitcoin price reaches $72.5K as US issues ‘Economic D-Day’ threat to Iran
articles.snippet: Bitcoin saw new multimonth highs above $72,500 even as US stocks cooled amid US threats of “economic warfare” with Iran.

articles.title: 200,000 fake AI ‘victims’ deployed to scam bait online fraudsters
articles.snippet: Apate’s 200,000 fake AI ‘victims’ are so good at scam baiting, the company has a monthly KPI for how many F-bombs scammers drop at the infuriating bots.

articles.title: XRP Notches Best Week Since 2024 Election Pump on Bitcoin Short Squeeze
articles.snippet: The token's steepest daily and weekly gains in months rode Bitcoin's record liquidation wave—though ETF flows and futures data hint the move is running on borrowed momentum.
